abstract: Mouse eggs were activated with hyaluronidase in vitro and subsequently transferred to the oviduct. In the female reproductive tract they formed morulae and blastocysts which died soon after implantation. Haploid blastocysts were transferred beneath the kidney capsule and here some formed disorganized egg-cylinder structures in a week. Morulae and blastocysts from haploid and diploid parthenogenones were also transferred beneath the testis capsule. Two to four months later the growths which had formed were sectioned. They contained neural tissue, pigment, keratinized epithelium, glandular epithelium, ciliated epithelium, cartilage, bone, muscle, adipose tissue, and haemopoietic tissue. The range of cell types was similar to that produced by fertilized control blastocysts except that the parthenogenones did not form identifiable yolk-sac carcinoma or embryonal carcinoma cells. The growths from haploid and diploid parthenogenones in the testis were stained with Feulgen and their DNA content measured. Growths from diploid embryos contained the normal diploid amount of DNA while growths from haploid embryos contained less than this amount. Cell cultures were prepared from the growths. The cells which were investigated contained no Y chromosome, suggesting that they were derived from the embryonic cells rather than the cells of the male host. These cells contained a near diploid chromosome number, although some of them were originally derived from haploid embryos.
abstract_ja: マウス卵子をin vitroでヒアルロニダーゼにより活性化し、その後卵管に移植した。雌性生殖路内では、桑実胚および胚盤胞を形成したが、着床後まもなく死滅した。半数体胚盤胞を腎被膜下に移植すると、一部は1週間以内に秩序を欠いた卵筒様構造を形成した。半数体および二倍体の単為生殖胚の桑実胚・胚盤胞は精巣被膜下にも移植された。2〜4か月後に形成された増殖塊を切片にして観察した。増殖塊には神経組織、色素、角化上皮、腺上皮、繊毛上皮、軟骨、骨、筋肉、脂肪組織、造血組織が含まれていた。細胞の種類の範囲は受精卵対照胚から生じたものと類似していたが、単為生殖胚では同定可能な卵黄嚢癌や胎児性癌の細胞は形成されなかった。精巣内の単為生殖増殖塊についてFeulgen染色によりDNA量を測定した。二倍体胚由来の増殖塊は正常な二倍体量のDNAを含んでいたが、半数体胚由来のものは通常より少なかった。増殖塊から細胞培養を作製した。調べた細胞はY染色体を含まず、ほぼ二倍体の染色体数を示したが、一部は元々半数体胚由来であった。これらの細胞は宿主の雄由来ではなく、胚細胞に由来すると考えられた。
